page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr6e.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance configured under the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated physical cores and 104 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The absence of local storage requires reliance on external block storage solutions, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated physical cores paired with a substantial memory footprint makes this instance type suitable for workloads requiring large-scale memory capacity and dedicated CPU execution without hyperthreading overhead.

Given the memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated core allocation, this instance is designed for memory-intensive enterprise applications. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
